checks.detail: Reviewed all candidate-bound runtime, interface, persistence, security, and visual evidence. Every receipt binds candidate 457f674650db with source_unchanged true; white-box lanes pass (tsc, vite build, rustfmt, rust-check, rust-unit 50/50 incl. rate limiting, private-op rejection, token expiry/reuse, restart persistence); product UI separation passes; receipts redact mail content and tokens. Six signed-in surfaces reviewed against PRD 8/9.1: Inbox with search/priority/due/completion filters and honest empty state, Projects board with Planned/In-progress/Done columns plus rename/archive/restore, Calendar month grid with Month/Agenda toggle and timezone note, Focus session history plus guided empty state, Settings with profile, timezone, reminder toggle, SENT delivery state, test-email action, password change, and revocable sessions; visual direction is calm editorial with restrained amber accent, thin rules, icon+text nav, and no prohibited patterns. The review is incomplete only on PRD 9.2: the fault-injected network-error state and the narrow-viewport Today reference state have no runtime capture (collector execute/sync HTTP 500 on all 12 responsive probes; network-error not_run), so the reference-board quality bar is not fully demonstrated.

Independent black-box progress this loop: the host journey drive consumed the pinned manifest and for the first time executed past auth — 7 of 8 executed steps passed with per-assertion checks and screenshots (landing shell, create account, registration, verification mail from the isolated sink, verified sign-in notice, sign-in plus reload persistence onto Today, project board with restrained accent). The drive is blocked at step 8/18 create_task with 'control not found: [data-testid=task-detail-toggle]'; 08-failure.png shows Today 'Nothing scheduled for today' with Inbox badge 1 — the product behaved PRD 6.3-correctly (a no-due-date quick-add task stays in Inbox), so the manifest's configure path targets an unreachable Today state, and the receipt reports independently_verified false with collector_exit_code 1. Host observation verification marks journey_drive and external_activation unmeasured (operation_not_passed). PRD steps 6-11 (task configuration, four-view presence, focus cycle with pause/resume, exact-once completion with daily summary, reminder mail, sign-out/in persistence) and all four recovery states remain without independent observation; rust-unit 50/50 and the product self-drive 16/16 are diagnostic, not journey proof. No observed product violation — the block is a measurement-contract incompatibility plus missing independent observations.

output_contract.risk_handoff_policy: Risk context is host-owned and must be echoed through bindings; Tester should explicitly inspect the stated validation result and cite bound evidence when risk remains unresolved.

required_criteria.requirement: Review candidate-bound runtime, interface, persistence, security, and visual evidence against the PRD.
Verify the complete auth, task, focus, reminder, recovery, and persistence path in both black-box and white-box layers.

developer_outcome.summary: Every predicate checked against shipped state. Unverified: opaque project-id select value (covered via Projects-column assertion); focus running/paused transitions not end-state predicates (final Completed asserted); exact-once count and '1 task completed.' sentence (no count predicate); reset two-phase headings need per-sub-action observation. Business pass gated on Host+Tester.

risk_note.summary: Valid assertion syntax may still reference an unreachable state or omit part of a business outcome.
risk_note.validation: Check every predicate against shipped state and report exact unverified outcomes; only independent Host evidence and Tester review establish business pass.
risk_note.why_now: The missing executable measurement contract currently prevents independent collection.

task_requirements.requirement: All 18 steps have executable predicates and all four navigation views have their own assertions accepted by the Host contract validator.
Every predicate observes the corresponding frozen business outcome using the shipped UI or isolated mail sink.
All required steps, recovery states, actions, locators and business outcomes are preserved; changes are confined to quality/first-run-journey.json.
The handoff identifies any unverified outcome or action incompatibility and leaves it blocked for independent measurement.
